name: per-window-theme
description: Give each VS Code window its own color theme, without workspace files.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Only reads its own settings and applies a color theme to this window; never executes workspace content.

perWindowTheme.enabled.description: Assign a distinct color theme to each window.

perWindowTheme.themes.markdownDescription: Ordered list of theme ids (the `settingsId`, i.e. the theme's `id` or its `label`). Window slot N gets entry N, wrapping around. Defaults are built-in themes so they resolve offline.

perWindowTheme.rememberFolders.markdownDescription: Remember a theme per folder, so the same directory always opens with the same theme. Stored in the extension's own state — never written to `.vscode/settings.json`.

enumDescriptions: Rotate through the theme list by window order: first window gets the first theme, and so on.
Derive the theme from the folder path, so an unremembered folder still gets a stable theme every time.
perWindowTheme.unmappedStrategy.description: How to choose a theme for a folder that has nothing remembered.

perWindowTheme.showStatusBar.description: Show the current window's theme in the status bar. Click it to pick a different one.

perWindowTheme.notifyOnFailure.description: Warn when a theme cannot be applied, instead of failing silently.

perWindowTheme.heartbeatMs.description: How often this window refreshes its slot claim.

perWindowTheme.staleMs.description: A slot claim not refreshed within this window is considered dead and reclaimable. Keep it a few times larger than the heartbeat.
